method: University summary of core search-fund research.

limitations: Plans, companies, participants and new ownership transactions are different units. Filing and processing create a lag.

title: Project Equity: employee ownership for manufacturers

title: SBA: 7(a) loans
limitations: The $5m maximum is a loan limit, not an acquisition-price limit or guaranteed approval. Eligibility and transaction terms require current lender review.

title: Census: nonemployer statistics by demographics
limitations: Nonemployer businesses are a separate population from employer-firm owner surveys. Neither population directly measures businesses for sale.
